step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture represents the Samsung Developer Portal built on AWS serverless container infrastructure. The system consists of GIT for source control pushing container images to ECR. User traffic is routed via Route 53 to a Frontend layer managed by an ELB and running on AWS Fargate/ECS tasks. The Frontend layer talks to a Backend microservices layer via a Backend ELB and backend AWS Fargate/ECS tasks. The entire structure is transcribed faithfully based on the visual components and audio transcript.
